material.acceptance_criteria: After load_state or swap_data every pack module cache is rebuilt from the sim (a host reset hook, or caches keyed on a sim generation the host bumps); effects, targeting and upgrades read the new sim on the next tick.
material.description: scenarios/moba/effects.lua:28-39 (hero_ids cached by unit count: a swap to data with the same count but other kinds keeps old heroes; seen_level/seen_alive/seen_xp survive), scenarios/moba/targeting.lua:105-111 (BUCKETS_FOR keyed on game.ticks(): load_state or a replay_seek to a tick already bucketed reuses the old GRID), scenarios/moba/upgrades.lua:25-27 (held/seen). rust/crates/web/src/lib.rs:151,175 swap and load do not tell the host. controls.lua QUEUE has its own row, controls-queued-orders-outside-sim-state.

material.witness_plan: Native mod-host test: run N ticks, save_state, tick to M, load_state, tick; state_hash equals an uninterrupted run. Browser: swap then compare level_ring effects.
